info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Account Data Access Tiers API
info.description: This API enables the management of data access tiers associated with customer accounts. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can define and update how data access is tiered for specific customer accounts, tailoring services to diverse client needs. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and service providers focused on enhancing customer data interaction. This integration allows for improved access control and resource allocation, ultimately streamlining customer data management processes.

post.summary: Create data access tiers for a customer account.
